description: gravel: base colour #BDB7B0, many small pebbles in slightly lighter and darker greys and beiges. It belongs to a district of the town with this look, which everything in the district shares: a former industrial quarter that is turning into offices: red and brown brick, dark steel frames, riveted iron, weathered green and rust-red paint, grey concrete; plain sturdy shapes, still friendly and cartoon-like, here and there a weed
